integrity: The proof gives three complete monitoring witness-pair tables, an exact structural criterion, a factorized counting polynomial, and a Cartesian-product exchange theorem. An adjacency-based BFS checker separately tests all 4096 vertex subsets and all optimal moves.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification only for the unweighted 12-vertex Dürer graph GP(6,2), not arbitrary generalized Petersen graphs. Later planar-network literature has only abstract-level comparison. No independent mathematical validation.
title: Monitoring-edge-geodetic sets of the Dürer graph: a factorized polynomial and a Cartesian product of claws
